source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed (Derry Journal, 6 October 1937: no contests in any ward)

note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each of the five wards of Londonderry Corporation, held in October after the ordinary day was moved for 1937; nominations Tuesday 5 October 1937. The Nationalists made no nominations, holding the election pointless with the whole Corporation due to retire in May 1938 under the new wards scheme; their retiring South and West councillors were expected to be returned automatically, so those wards' ordinary vacancies are not recorded here; Michael M'Nutt was nominated, unopposed, for an extra South Ward vacancy. The Unionist nominees in North, East and Waterside were returned unopposed and there was no poll (Derry Journal, 6 October 1937). Returned unopposed.
